scope: Current-state-only domain and symbolic computational census of the exact original160000 training references under the frozen cap4 conditional law. No physical response, observation likelihood, latent cache construction or fitting.
basis: The selected9 fixed-zero cases have local support and synthetic cached gradients are correct. This does not establish that the original complete training target is defined or computationally feasible. A real9-case readout already required6864 full-forward calls and54.74min.

fixed.manifest: training_reservoir_server_only.json: the exact saved original reservoir used by tsc_packet_mean_alignment_20261110 and tsc_packet_shared_population_20261110. Do not resample/refill/relabel.
fixed.inputs: Existing static graph, frozen target-history laws, current observed frames and same-interval applied signal states. Use no next-frame labels, native start/entry/LC outcome labels, measured travel, likelihood or costs.
fixed.nuisance_seed: 76116999+seed*100000+time_sec, identical to the original current-state registration.
fixed.geometry: Reuse GeometryView, unchanged select_stochastic and symbolic_budget; maximum_stochastic_actors remains4. Preserve current internal-binding behavior and report ambiguity/fallback counts; add no new rejection threshold.

implementation: Recover all original references from the saved manifest, grouped by current frame; stream each of the four existing1800s training logs once. Decode only required current frames and aligned actions; do not form current/next observation pairs.

For every exact current case, register the unchanged geometry-based required set and cap4 domain, positive-prior intent availability and current head eligibility. Compute symbolic forward/receiving/LC-leaf upper bounds only where defined.

Retain compact per-reference dispositions on the server. Count all original records, including out-of-domain and outside-head-selector cases; use deterministic first examples for diagnostic geometry, never select by a future label or response.

Report bounds both with exact-case sharing and with original reference multiplicities. A defined-subset sum is explicitly partial; a full-target bound exists only if every required case/head is defined.

Instrument or forbid response/feature preparation paths while the current-only registration runs. No MotionResolver, endpoint forecast, LC probability, observation likelihood or cached-law build is permitted.
readouts: Complete160000-reference accounting by seed/head, unique current-case count, required-set-size distribution, head-selector eligibility and all obstruction reasons.
Physical-frame sizes, binding ambiguity/fallback counts, positive-prior domain coverage and deterministic representative current geometry.
Whole-target symbolic full-forward and LC-leaf bounds if defined; otherwise counts and clearly partial in-domain bounds, with sharing distinguished from repeated references.
Current-only execution time and explicit0 physical/likelihood/cache/fitting calls. Measured prior runtime may provide context, not a rigorous extrapolated time bound.
decision: Determine whether the original full target is currently in the declared domain and what exact enumeration would cost. A domain failure remains a failure of that complete target; do not silently replace it with the defined subset, fit only the selected9, prune required actors or increase cap4.
after: Stop after the complete current-only census or technical HOLD. No automatic response enumeration or real cache/fitting follows a pass. Use the registered coverage/cost to propose a separate feasible training design or a formulation change.
storage: Keep all frames, original reservoir arrays and per-reference details on the server; pull only compact JSON summaries and logs, never models or full trajectories.
